segments.speaker: Conference Operator
segments.text: Good afternoon and welcome to the Acme Cloud Systems fourth quarter fiscal 2025 earnings conference call.

segments.speaker: Elena Vance
segments.text: Thank you, operator. In Q4 FY2025, total revenue was $420 million. Non-GAAP operating margin reached 24.5% in Q4 FY2025. For full-year FY2026, we expect total revenue of $1.80 billion to $1.85 billion.

segments.speaker: Marcus Thorne
segments.text: Thanks, Elena. Q4 FY2025 non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.42 per share, and free cash flow totaled $96 million. For Q1 FY2026, we guide total revenue of $430 million to $440 million. For FY2026, we reaffirm non-GAAP operating margin of 25.0% to 26.0%, subject to macro headwinds and hardware supply visibility. We also expect FY2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.80 to $6.00 per share.

segments.speaker: Priya Nair
segments.text: Can you comment on whether customer churn changed this quarter and whether you expect revenue of $500 million in Q1 FY2026?

segments.speaker: Marcus Thorne
segments.text: We do not disclose quarterly customer churn figures. Our Q1 FY2026 guidance remains as stated in prepared remarks.
